about: The inputs the h5j profile rejects, each with the start of its message (the Rust tests' prefix), and, where the Python host rejects it earlier, the host's message; each case has the `profile` h5j and is given to the host named as that profile's input, since a file the HDF5 profile chose H5J for with no channel to present is the HDF5 profile's, which accepts it (spec/zarrify/h5j.md §8.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/h5j.md#83-checks>). rust/refkv-ir/build.rs writes a Rust test per case into tests/h5j.rs; python/tests/ir/test_rejects.py checks each through the host and that every rejected fixture is listed here.
